description: Kismet Cartographer: last-line-of-defence normalisation. Stamps event.ingested, strips any geo point that is out of range or (0,0), and drops a 0 RSSI (Kismet's 'no signal' sentinel). The ingester already does this; the pipeline protects the index from any other writer.

script.description: geo.location / geo.peak_signal_location must be a real point
0 dBm RSSI is Kismet's absent-signal sentinel
script.source: if (ctx.wifi != null) { def r = ctx.wifi.get('rssi'); if (r instanceof Number && r.doubleValue() == 0.0) { ctx.wifi.remove('rssi'); } }
